cases.name: a .NET solution in the clean-architecture shape: preset first, product and xunit read off the manifests
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/ds-{{SID}}
mkdir -p $R/src/Acme.Application/Catalog/CreateProduct $R/tests/Acme.UnitTests
printf x > $R/Acme.sln
printf '<PackageReference Include="xunit.v3"/>' > $R/tests/Acme.UnitTests/Acme.UnitTests.csproj
printf 'public sealed class CreateProductCommandHandler { }' > $R/src/Acme.Application/Catalog/CreateProduct/CreateProductCommandHandler.cs
python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/detect-stack.py $R | jq -r '[.product, .testTag, .presets[0].preset, (.presets[0].useCaseFolders|tostring), (.fits|tostring)] | join("|")'

cases.name: a pytest repo with feature folders: vertical-slices first, pytest tag
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/ds-{{SID}}
mkdir -p $R/src/features/create_product
printf '[project]
name = "shop"
dependencies = ["pytest"]
' > $R/pyproject.toml
printf 'class CreateProductHandler:
    async def handle(self, c):
        pass
' > $R/src/features/create_product/create_product_handler.py
python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/detect-stack.py $R | jq -r '[.product, .testTag, .presets[0].preset] | join("|")'

cases.name: no use-case folder anywhere: fits is false, the layers are listed for the draft rules
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/ds-{{SID}}
mkdir -p $R/src/billing $R/src/shipping
printf '{"name":"@acme/store","devDependencies":{"vitest":"1"}}' > $R/package.json
printf 'export const x = 1' > $R/src/billing/invoice.ts
printf 'export const y = 1' > $R/src/shipping/parcel.ts
python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/detect-stack.py $R | jq -r '[.product, .testTag, (.fits|tostring), ([.layers[].dir]|join(","))] | join("|")'
